source.lineage: same frozen SW0097 seed1 mapped by SW0135 to native32
source.ordering: exact registered seed1 source TRAIN order
source.teacher_graph: frozen source encoder, native32 patcher, and learned source graph; recomputed per microbatch; no temporal source rollout or adjacency cache

dynamics.student_relation: unchanged production actual-spike Q from SW0145._actual_q / spike_synchrony_affinity affinity_mode=spike

objective.source_adjacency: A is the frozen source graph output symmetrized, with its diagonal set to zero; finite and nonnegative
objective.loss: per-image -sum(M*Q)/Z, averaged over the batch; Q's diagonal is the fixed self-similarity one, while all off-diagonal values are unchanged production actual-spike Q

arms.encoder_graph: train native32 encoder and graph; freeze remaining native core and all 12 integration scalar values
arms.joint: train native32 encoder, graph, remaining native core, and all 12 integration scalar values

training.optimizer: fresh Adam per arm; encoder LR 3e-6, graph/native core LR 3e-5, integration scalars LR 1e-3; global clip 1; project a_d/a_m to [0,1]
training.initialization: same fresh mapped source97 seed1 state for both arms; never initialize from SW0148 trained weights

required: verified existing exact SW0135 seed1 native parity
positive and negative off-diagonal modularity contributions on first64 TRAIN images
two disposable real logical optimizer updates per arm with family gradient and parameter-change records

evaluation.ground_truth_access: after both candidate prediction archives and protocols plus source97 seed1 and Slot32 seed1 references are validated and rehashed

promotion.joint_fg_mean: at least 0.01 greater than source97 seed1 and encoder_graph control
promotion.paired_fg_ci: 95% lower bounds for joint-control and joint-source per-image FG ARI differences both positive
promotion.iou: joint FG-IoU and object-IoU exceed registered three-seed Slot32 means by 0.05
promotion.failure: close this fixed recipe without coefficient, threshold, or density sweeps

limits: The source graph is a fixed reference, not semantic ground truth.
CPU fixtures do not admit training; the registered actual-source GPU preflight is required.
A seed1 pilot does not prove all-gate necessity or fresh-initialization data scaling.
